recentItems.title: Amid Toxic’s Failure, Kiara Advani Gets Candid About Her Most Intense Scene''I had given it my all''
recentItems.description:
Kiara Advani has opened up about her experience shooting Toxic: A Fairytale For Grown-Ups amid the film’s underwhelming box-office performance. The actress recalled filming an intense scene as Nadia and said, “I had given it my all,” revealing how physically and emotionally drained she felt after the shoot. Kiara also opened up about challenging roles, conserving her energy and why she doesn’t want to “build a box” around herself as an actor.Watch the complete video to know more.
